question_text: In a labor dispute, a group of workers claims that their employer violated their right to form a union. The employer argues that Philippine law does not recognize this right. Which of the following statements best reflects the application of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) in Philippine domestic law?

options.text: The UDHR is automatically enforceable in Philippine courts because the Philippines is a member of the United Nations.
The UDHR provisions are not directly enforceable in Philippine courts unless they are incorporated into domestic legislation.
The UDHR can be invoked only if the case involves a violation by the government, not by a private employer.
The UDHR supersedes all Philippine laws because it is an international treaty ratified by the Philippines.
